name: Tracwell · Interactive demo

title.zh: Tracwell · 适合需要把网站流量、注册和收

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Tracwell 是面向创始人和小团队的产品分析工具，可跟踪访问、注册与支付，并把收入归因到来源页面和活动。页面提供可交互 Demo，可查看 Overview、Realtime、Acquisition、AI crawlers、Activity、Conversions、Revenue 等示例报表；还说明可通过 MCP 让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或 VS Code 读取同一份分析数据。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Tracwell (https://tracwell.app/).
Technology stack: react-native.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
